SELECT u.* FROM (
    /* =======================================================================
       NHÁNH 1 · CẤP THÀNH PHỐ (qlnv_task):
         task có TopicCode LIKE '%"NQ57%': Trung ương giao (AssignDepartment 900000.900609%) + Thành phố giao (490.%)
       ======================================================================= */
    SELECT
        /* 0. CẤP NHIỆM VỤ (phân biệt nhiệm vụ cấp TP / cấp xã, phường trong cùng bảng) */
        'Cấp Thành phố'                                         AS cap_nhiem_vu,

        /* 1. KHÓA HỆ THỐNG & TRẠNG THÁI */
        t.TaskId                                                AS task_id,
        t.Status                                                AS status,

        /* 2. TRỤC GIAO & VĂN BẢN GIAO */
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2)             AS id_truc_giao,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, ''), d_assign_cap2.name) AS truc_giao,

        /* NGUỒN GIAO */
        CASE

            /* Trung ương giao: AssignDepartment 900000.900609% */
            WHEN tw.TaskId IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'Nhiệm vụ Trung ương'

            /* Còn lại: Thành ủy, HĐND, UBND TP, sở ngành TP giao */
            ELSE 'Nhiệm vụ Thành phố'
        END                                                     AS nguon_giao,
        /* Số văn bản một dạng ('1' = nhiệm vụ trọng tâm hiển thị 'TT'): bỏ 'Số:', bỏ khoảng trắng quanh '-' '/';
           mã viết tắt (không có '/', vd NQ79) -> số ký hiệu đầy đủ của văn bản (qlnv_resolution) */
        CASE
            WHEN TRIM(t.DocCode) = '1' THEN 'TT'
            ELSE TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.DocCode, '') NOT LIKE '%/%' AND NULLIF(TRIM(r_vb.DocCode), '') IS NOT NULL THEN r_vb.DocCode ELSE t.DocCode END, 'Số:', ''), 'số:', ''), 'SỐ:', ''), ' -', '-'), ' -', '-'), '- ', '-'), '- ', '-'), ' /', '/'), ' /', '/'), '/ ', '/'), '/ ', '/'))
        END                                                     AS van_ban_giao,
        /* Loại văn bản (4 nhóm):
             TT (DocCode = '1')                    -> NV trọng tâm
             mã chứa 'KH' (vd 20-KH/BCĐ57)          -> Kế hoạch
             mã chứa 'TB' hoặc 'KL' (gồm cả TBKL)  -> TBKL
             còn lại (kể cả rỗng)                  -> Công văn */
        CASE
            /* Số văn bản '1' -> nhiệm vụ trọng tâm (TT) */
            WHEN TRIM(t.DocCode) = 'TT'                                    THEN 'NV trọng tâm'
            WHEN UPPER(t.DocCode) LIKE '%KH%'                                  THEN 'Kế hoạch'
            WHEN UPPER(t.DocCode) LIKE '%TB%' OR UPPER(t.DocCode) LIKE '%KL%'   THEN 'TBKL'
            ELSE 'Công văn'
        END                                                     AS loai_van_ban,

        /* 3. THÔNG TIN NHIỆM VỤ, TIÊU ĐỀ & CHỦ ĐỀ */
        t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
        /* 02. Tên xã/phường chuẩn ('Phường Ba Đình'), chỉ khi cơ quan xã nhận */
        COALESCE(xa_nhan.ten_xa_phuong, xa_goc.ten_xa_phuong) AS ten_xa_phuong,
        t.Title                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(tp.TopicName, ''), 'Chưa phân loại')    AS chu_de,
        /* Nhóm nhiệm vụ NQ57 một dạng ('Nhóm 11: ...'), bỏ ký tự thừa ở đầu ('. Nhóm 8') */
        COALESCE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(IF(t.NameGroup REGEXP 'Nhóm [0-9]', SUBSTRING(t.NameGroup, LOCATE('Nhóm ', t.NameGroup)), TRIM(LEADING '.' FROM TRIM(t.NameGroup)))), '')), 'Chưa phân loại') AS nhom_nhiem_vu,

        /* ĐƠN VỊ GIAO & NGƯỜI GIAO */
        t.AssignDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_giao,
        /* Cơ quan ban hành / giao nhiệm vụ, không lấy đơn vị nhập liệu (d_assign) trước */
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(r_vb.AssignOrganizationName), ''),
            NULLIF(TRIM(t.AssignOrganization), ''),
            d_assign.name
        )                                                       AS don_vi_giao,
        t.AssignUser                                            AS id_nguoi_giao,
        u_assign.eGovUserFullname                               AS nguoi_giao,

        /* 4. ĐƠN VỊ THỰC HIỆN / CHỦ TRÌ & NGƯỜI THỰC HIỆN */
        /* Path mã tới đơn vị nhận, không để trống (thiếu thì lấy đơn vị nhận gốc, cuối cùng là '490') */
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490') AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,
        /* Tên của mã sâu nhất trong path (không phải tên nhóm cha) */
        COALESCE(
            dp6.name, dp5.name, dp4.name, dp3.name, dp2.name,
            NULLIF(t.ResponsibleUnit, ''),
            NULLIF(t.TargetOrganization, ''),
            dp1.name
        )                                                       AS ten_don_vi_chu_tri,
    
        COALESCE(
            d_donvi.name,
            NULLIF(t.ResponsibleUnit, ''),
            NULLIF(t.TargetOrganization, '')
        )                                                       AS ten_don_vi_thuc_hien,

        t.TargetUser                                            AS id_nguoi_thuc_hien,
        u_target.eGovUserFullname                               AS nguoi_thuc_hien,

        /* Lãnh đạo ban phụ trách */
        CONCAT_WS(' · ',
            COALESCE(u_target.eGovUserPositionName, NULLIF(t.ChargeUser, ''))
        )                                                       AS lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach,

        /* 5. CÁC MỐC THỜI GIAN */
        DATE_FORMAT(t.StartedDate, '%Y-%m-%d')                  AS ngay_giao,
        DATE_FORMAT(t.ExpireDate, '%Y-%m-%d')                   AS han_xu_ly,
        DATE_FORMAT(t.CompletedDate, '%Y-%m-%d')                AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
        DATE_FORMAT(t.ApprovedDate, '%Y-%m-%d')                 AS ngay_chap_nhan,
        DATE_FORMAT(t.DeletedDate, '%Y-%m-%d')                  AS ngay_xoa,

        /* 6. PHÂN LOẠI 4 TÌNH TRẠNG CHUẨN */
        CASE
            /* NV Trung ương giao (tw): Status = 4 + IsRecurring = 0 -> hoàn thành; IsRecurring = 1 -> thường xuyên */
            WHEN tw.TaskId IS NOT NULL AND t.Status = 4 AND COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0
            THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'
            WHEN tw.TaskId IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 1
            THEN 'Thường xuyên'
            WHEN tw.TaskId IS NOT NULL
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE()
            THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
            WHEN tw.TaskId IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'

            /* 1. Đã hoàn thành (đúng hạn hoặc quá hạn) */
            WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
  /*               AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL */
            THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'

            /* 2. Thường xuyên (nhiệm vụ không có hạn) */
            WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NULL
            THEN 'Thường xuyên'

            /* 3. Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn */
            WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE()
            THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'

            /* 4. Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn */
            WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE()
            THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
        END                                                     AS tinh_trang,

        /* Tiến độ (%): đã hoàn thành/kết thúc tính 100 */
        IF(IF(tw.TaskId IS NOT NULL, t.Status = 4 AND COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0, t.Status IN (3, 4)), 100, COALESCE(t.Progress, 0)) AS tien_do,

        /* 7. CHI TIẾT TÌNH HÌNH & BÁO CÁO (Lấy bản ghi mới nhất) */
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT rp.Content 
                FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp 
                WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId 
                  AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL 
                ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC 
                LIMIT 1
            ), 
            t.Content,
            '—'
        )                                                       AS ket_qua_thuc_hien,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT NULLIF(rp.Difficulty, '') 
                FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp 
                WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId 
                  AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL 
                ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC 
                LIMIT 1
            ), 
            '—'
        )                                                       AS kho_khan_vuong_mac,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT NULLIF(rp.Suggestion, '') 
                FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp 
                WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId 
                  AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL 
                ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC 
                LIMIT 1
            ), 
            '—'
        )                                                       AS de_xuat_kien_nghi,

        /* ===== BỔ SUNG THEO test/dac-ta-truong-bcd57.md ===== */
        /* 01. Path tên tương ứng id_don_vi_chu_tri, ngăn cách ' › ' */
        CONCAT_WS(' › ',
            IF(dp1.id = 490, 'Thành phố Hà Nội', dp1.name),
            dp2.name, dp3.name, dp4.name, dp5.name, dp6.name
        )                                                       AS path_ten_don_vi_chu_tri,

        /* 02. Xã/phường và trục của cơ quan xã nhận (dm_xa_phuong_4truc); nhiệm vụ không thuộc cấp xã -> NULL */
        COALESCE(xa_nhan.ma_xa_phuong, xa_goc.ma_xa_phuong) AS ma_xa_phuong,
        COALESCE(xa_nhan.truc_xa_phuong, xa_goc.truc_xa_phuong) AS truc_xa_phuong,

        /* 03. Nhãn chuyên đề dạng path 'NQ57/<TopicName>': lấy từ qlnv_task.TopicCode (chuỗi JSON ["NQ57.TCCĐ", "NQ57.CĐN"])
               join qlnv_task_topic (con của Code 'NQ57', mã đầy đủ = 'NQ57.' + Code); nhiều nhãn ngăn cách ';';
               không có nhãn con -> 'Khác' */
        COALESCE((SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(p57.Code, '/', c57.TopicName) ORDER BY c57.SortOrder SEPARATOR ';')
                    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task_topic` c57
                    JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task_topic` p57 ON p57.TopicId = c57.ParentTopicId
                   WHERE p57.Code = 'NQ57' AND p57.DeletedDate IS NULL
                     AND c57.Code IS NOT NULL AND c57.DeletedDate IS NULL
                     AND t.TopicCode LIKE CONCAT('%"', p57.Code, '.', c57.Code, '"%')), 'Khác') AS nhan_chuyen_de,

        /* 04. Ngày ban hành, trích yếu văn bản giao */
        DATE(r_vb.StartDate)                                    AS ngay_ban_hanh_vb,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(r_vb.Compendium), ''),
            NULLIF(TRIM(t.Compendium), '')
        )                                                       AS trich_yeu_vb,

        /* 06. Số thứ tự nhóm NQ57 (số sau 'Nhóm ') để sắp xếp */
        CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(IF(t.NameGroup REGEXP 'Nhóm [0-9]', SUBSTRING(t.NameGroup, LOCATE('Nhóm ', t.NameGroup)), TRIM(LEADING '.' FROM TRIM(t.NameGroup)))), '')), 6), ':', 1), ' ', 1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(IF(t.NameGroup REGEXP 'Nhóm [0-9]', SUBSTRING(t.NameGroup, LOCATE('Nhóm ', t.NameGroup)), TRIM(LEADING '.' FROM TRIM(t.NameGroup)))), '')), 6), ':', 1), ' ', 1) AS UNSIGNED)
        END                                                     AS stt_nhom_nhiem_vu,

        /* 07. Thường trực BCĐ 57: chủ trì là Công an TP/xã, Tổ Thường trực, Tổ Tư vấn - chuyên gia */
        IF(CONCAT_WS(' ', dp2.name, dp3.name, dp4.name, dp5.name, dp6.name, t.ResponsibleUnit) LIKE '%Công an%'
           OR CONCAT_WS(' ', dp2.name, dp3.name, dp4.name, dp5.name, dp6.name, t.ResponsibleUnit) LIKE '%Tổ Thường trực%'
           OR CONCAT_WS(' ', dp2.name, dp3.name, dp4.name, dp5.name, dp6.name, t.ResponsibleUnit) LIKE '%Tổ Tư vấn%',
           1, 0)                                                AS la_thuong_truc_bcd,

        '${sync_ts}'                                            AS sync_date

    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

    /* CHỦ ĐỀ (1 TopicId / task -> không nhân dòng) */
    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task_topic` tp
           ON tp.TopicId = t.TopicId

    /* JOIN TÊN ĐƠN VỊ TRỤC GIAO CẤP 2 */
    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign_cap2
           ON d_assign_cap2.id = CASE
                WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
                ELSE NULL
              END
          AND d_assign_cap2.IsDelete = 0

    /* JOIN ĐƠN VỊ GIAO (BÓC TÁCH ID TỪ T.ASSIGNDEPARTMENT ĐỂ LẤY TÊN) */
    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign
           ON d_assign.id = CASE
                WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
                ELSE NULL
              END
          AND d_assign.IsDelete = 0

    /* JOIN NGƯỜI GIAO NHIỆM VỤ */
    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_assign
           ON u_assign.eGovUserId = t.AssignUser

    /* JOIN DANH MỤC PHÒNG BAN ĐƠN VỊ NHẬN */
    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_cap
           ON d_cap.id = CASE
                WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
                ELSE NULL
              END
          AND d_cap.IsDelete = 0

    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_donvi
           ON d_donvi.id = CASE
                WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
                ELSE NULL
              END
          AND d_donvi.IsDelete = 0

    /* JOIN USER NHẬN */
    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target 
           ON u_target.eGovUserId = t.TargetUser

    /* VĂN BẢN GIAO (số, ngày ban hành, trích yếu, cơ quan ban hành) */
    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r_vb
           ON r_vb.ResolutionId = t.ResolutionId
          AND r_vb.DeletedDate IS NULL

    /* PATH ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ: dp1..dp6 = department của từng mã trong path
       COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490') */

    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` dp1
           ON dp1.id = CASE
                WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 1), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 1), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
              END

    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` dp2
           ON dp2.id = CASE
                WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', '')) >= 1
                 AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 2), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 2), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
              END

    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` dp3
           ON dp3.id = CASE
                WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', '')) >= 2
                 AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 3), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 3), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
              END

    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` dp4
           ON dp4.id = CASE
                WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', '')) >= 3
                 AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 4), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 4), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
              END

    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` dp5
           ON dp5.id = CASE
                WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', '')) >= 4
                 AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 5), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 5), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
              END

    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` dp6
           ON dp6.id = CASE
                WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', '')) >= 5
                 AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 6), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 6), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
              END

    /* XÃ/PHƯỜNG NHẬN: đơn vị chủ trì là cơ quan cấp xã (bảng đối chiếu dm_xa_phuong_4truc_ddl.sql) */
    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`dm_xa_phuong_4truc` xa_nhan
           ON xa_nhan.id_don_vi = CASE
                WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 4), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 4), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
              END
          AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490') LIKE CONCAT(xa_nhan.nhanh, '.%')

    /* XÃ/PHƯỜNG NHẬN theo đơn vị nhận gốc (OriginalTargetDepartment) */
    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`dm_xa_phuong_4truc` xa_goc
           ON xa_goc.id_don_vi = CASE
                WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
              END
          AND t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE CONCAT(xa_goc.nhanh, '.%')


    /* NHIỆM VỤ TRUNG ƯƠNG GIAO: TopicCode NQ57 + AssignDepartment 900000.900609% (1 dòng / task) */
    LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT t_tw.TaskId
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t_tw
            WHERE t_tw.DeletedDate IS NULL
              AND t_tw.TopicCode LIKE '%"NQ57%'
              AND t_tw.AssignDepartment LIKE '900000.900609%'
    ) tw
           ON tw.TaskId = t.TaskId

    /* Dòng gốc NV Thành phố giao nhiều chủ trì (TargetDepartment rỗng) -> để loại dòng con trùng Title */
    LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT g.Title
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` g
            WHERE g.DeletedDate IS NULL
              AND g.TopicCode LIKE '%"NQ57%'
              AND g.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.%'
              AND NULLIF(TRIM(g.TargetDepartment), '') IS NULL
    ) goc57
           ON goc57.Title = t.Title

    /* ĐIỀU KIỆN LẤY TASK: TopicCode NQ57 (qlnv_task), Trung ương giao (900000.900609%) hoặc Thành phố giao (490.%) */
    WHERE t.DeletedDate IS NULL
      AND t.TopicCode LIKE '%"NQ57%'
      AND (
             /* Trung ương giao: có đơn vị nhận */
             (t.AssignDepartment LIKE '900000.900609%' AND NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), '') IS NOT NULL)
             /* Thành phố giao: 1 dòng / nhiệm vụ. TH1 (1 chủ trì) = dòng có TargetDepartment;
                TH2 (nhiều chủ trì) = chỉ lấy dòng gốc TargetDepartment rỗng, bỏ các dòng con trùng Title */
          OR (t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.%'
              AND (NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), '') IS NULL OR goc57.Title IS NULL))
      )

    GROUP BY t.TaskId

    UNION ALL

    /* =======================================================================
       NHÁNH 2 · CẤP XÃ, PHƯỜNG: nhiệm vụ BCĐ 57 có xã/phường giao hoặc nhận (qlnv_task)
       ======================================================================= */
    SELECT
        /* 0. CẤP NHIỆM VỤ */
        'Cấp Xã, phường'     AS cap_nhiem_vu,

        /* 1. KHÓA HỆ THỐNG & TRẠNG THÁI */
        t.TaskId                                                AS task_id,
        t.Status                                                AS status,

        /* 2. TRỤC GIAO & VĂN BẢN GIAO */
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2)             AS id_truc_giao,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, ''), d_assign_cap2.name) AS truc_giao,

        /* NGUỒN GIAO (nhánh 1 chỉ có BCĐ / Thành phố; Trung ương lấy ở nhánh 2) */
        CASE
            /* Ban Chỉ đạo giao / bút phê, chỉ đạo: bỏ nhóm 'Nhiệm vụ Ban Chỉ đạo' -> NULL */
            WHEN CONCAT_WS(' ', t.AssignOrganization, d_assign.name, u_assign.eGovUserPositionName)
                     LIKE '%Ban Chỉ đạo%'
              OR t.DocCode LIKE '%BCĐ%'
            THEN NULL

            /* Còn lại: Thành ủy, HĐND, UBND TP, sở ngành TP giao */
            ELSE 'Nhiệm vụ Thành phố'
        END                                                     AS nguon_giao,
        /* Số văn bản một dạng ('1' = nhiệm vụ trọng tâm hiển thị 'TT'): bỏ 'Số:', bỏ khoảng trắng quanh '-' '/';
           mã viết tắt (không có '/', vd NQ79) -> số ký hiệu đầy đủ của văn bản (qlnv_resolution) */
        CASE
            WHEN TRIM(t.DocCode) = '1' THEN 'TT'
            ELSE TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.DocCode, '') NOT LIKE '%/%' AND NULLIF(TRIM(r_vb.DocCode), '') IS NOT NULL THEN r_vb.DocCode ELSE t.DocCode END, 'Số:', ''), 'số:', ''), 'SỐ:', ''), ' -', '-'), ' -', '-'), '- ', '-'), '- ', '-'), ' /', '/'), ' /', '/'), '/ ', '/'), '/ ', '/'))
        END                                                     AS van_ban_giao,
        /* Loại văn bản (4 nhóm):
             TT (DocCode = '1')                    -> NV trọng tâm
             mã chứa 'KH' (vd 20-KH/BCĐ57)          -> Kế hoạch
             mã chứa 'TB' hoặc 'KL' (gồm cả TBKL)  -> TBKL
             còn lại (kể cả rỗng)                  -> Công văn */
        CASE
            /* Số văn bản '1' -> nhiệm vụ trọng tâm (TT) */
            WHEN TRIM(t.DocCode) = 'TT'                                    THEN 'NV trọng tâm'
            WHEN UPPER(t.DocCode) LIKE '%KH%'                                  THEN 'Kế hoạch'
            WHEN UPPER(t.DocCode) LIKE '%TB%' OR UPPER(t.DocCode) LIKE '%KL%'   THEN 'TBKL'
            ELSE 'Công văn'
        END                                                     AS loai_van_ban,

        /* 3. THÔNG TIN NHIỆM VỤ, TIÊU ĐỀ & CHỦ ĐỀ */
        t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
        /* TÊN XÃ/PHƯỜNG (xem JOIN d_xa), đồng bộ qlnv_lichsutiendo_captp_xp_bcd57 */
        /* 02. Tên xã/phường chuẩn ('Phường Ba Đình'): xã nhận -> xã giao -> tên UBND xã cũ */
        COALESCE(xa_nhan.ten_xa_phuong, xa_goc.ten_xa_phuong, xa_giao.ten_xa_phuong, d_xa.name) AS ten_xa_phuong,
        t.Title                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(tp.TopicName, ''), 'Chưa phân loại')    AS chu_de,
        /* Nhóm nhiệm vụ NQ57 một dạng ('Nhóm 11: ...'), bỏ ký tự thừa ở đầu ('. Nhóm 8') */
        COALESCE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(IF(t.NameGroup REGEXP 'Nhóm [0-9]', SUBSTRING(t.NameGroup, LOCATE('Nhóm ', t.NameGroup)), TRIM(LEADING '.' FROM TRIM(t.NameGroup)))), '')), 'Chưa phân loại') AS nhom_nhiem_vu,

        /* ĐƠN VỊ GIAO & NGƯỜI GIAO */
        t.AssignDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_giao,
        /* Cơ quan ban hành / giao nhiệm vụ, không lấy đơn vị nhập liệu (d_assign) trước */
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(r_vb.AssignOrganizationName), ''),
            NULLIF(TRIM(t.AssignOrganization), ''),
            d_assign.name
        )                                                       AS don_vi_giao,
        t.AssignUser                                            AS id_nguoi_giao,
        u_assign.eGovUserFullname                               AS nguoi_giao,

        /* 4. ĐƠN VỊ THỰC HIỆN / CHỦ TRÌ & NGƯỜI THỰC HIỆN */
        /* Path mã tới đơn vị nhận, không để trống (thiếu thì lấy đơn vị nhận gốc, cuối cùng là '490') */
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490') AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,
        /* Tên của mã sâu nhất trong path (không phải tên nhóm cha) */
        COALESCE(
            dp6.name, dp5.name, dp4.name, dp3.name, dp2.name,
            NULLIF(t.ResponsibleUnit, ''),
            NULLIF(t.TargetOrganization, ''),
            dp1.name
        )                                                       AS ten_don_vi_chu_tri,
    
        COALESCE(
            d_donvi.name,
            NULLIF(t.ResponsibleUnit, ''),
            NULLIF(t.TargetOrganization, '')
        )                                                       AS ten_don_vi_thuc_hien,

        t.TargetUser                                            AS id_nguoi_thuc_hien,
        u_target.eGovUserFullname                               AS nguoi_thuc_hien,

        /* Lãnh đạo ban phụ trách */
        CONCAT_WS(' · ',
            COALESCE(u_target.eGovUserPositionName, NULLIF(t.ChargeUser, ''))
        )                                                       AS lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach,

        /* 5. CÁC MỐC THỜI GIAN */
        DATE_FORMAT(t.StartedDate, '%Y-%m-%d')                  AS ngay_giao,
        DATE_FORMAT(t.ExpireDate, '%Y-%m-%d')                   AS han_xu_ly,
        DATE_FORMAT(t.CompletedDate, '%Y-%m-%d')                AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
        DATE_FORMAT(t.ApprovedDate, '%Y-%m-%d')                 AS ngay_chap_nhan,
        DATE_FORMAT(t.DeletedDate, '%Y-%m-%d')                  AS ngay_xoa,

        /* 6. PHÂN LOẠI 4 TÌNH TRẠNG CHUẨN */
        CASE
            /* 1. Đã hoàn thành (đúng hạn hoặc quá hạn) */
            WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
                --  AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
                --  AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'

            /* 2. Thường xuyên (nhiệm vụ không có hạn) */
            WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NULL
            THEN 'Thường xuyên'

            /* 3. Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn */
            WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE()
            THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'

            /* 4. Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn */
            WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE()
            THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
        END                                                     AS tinh_trang,

        /* Tiến độ (%): đã hoàn thành/kết thúc tính 100 */
        IF(t.Status IN (3, 4), 100, COALESCE(t.Progress, 0))    AS tien_do,

        /* 7. CHI TIẾT TÌNH HÌNH & BÁO CÁO (Lấy bản ghi mới nhất) */
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT rp.Content 
                FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp 
                WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId 
                  AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL 
                ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC 
                LIMIT 1
            ), 
            t.Content,
            '—'
        )                                                       AS ket_qua_thuc_hien,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT NULLIF(rp.Difficulty, '') 
                FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp 
                WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId 
                  AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL 
                ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC 
                LIMIT 1
            ), 
            '—'
        )                                                       AS kho_khan_vuong_mac,

        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT NULLIF(rp.Suggestion, '') 
                FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp 
                WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId 
                  AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL 
                ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC 
                LIMIT 1
            ), 
            '—'
        )                                                       AS de_xuat_kien_nghi,

        /* ===== BỔ SUNG THEO test/dac-ta-truong-bcd57.md ===== */
        /* 01. Path tên tương ứng id_don_vi_chu_tri, ngăn cách ' › ' */
        CONCAT_WS(' › ',
            IF(dp1.id = 490, 'Thành phố Hà Nội', dp1.name),
            dp2.name, dp3.name, dp4.name, dp5.name, dp6.name
        )                                                       AS path_ten_don_vi_chu_tri,

        /* 02. Xã/phường và trục của cơ quan xã nhận (dm_xa_phuong_4truc); nhiệm vụ không thuộc cấp xã -> NULL */
        COALESCE(xa_nhan.ma_xa_phuong, xa_goc.ma_xa_phuong, xa_giao.ma_xa_phuong) AS ma_xa_phuong,
        COALESCE(xa_nhan.truc_xa_phuong, xa_goc.truc_xa_phuong, xa_giao.truc_xa_phuong) AS truc_xa_phuong,

        /* 03. Nhãn chuyên đề dạng path 'NQ57/<TopicName>': lấy từ qlnv_task.TopicCode (chuỗi JSON ["NQ57.TCCĐ", "NQ57.CĐN"])
               join qlnv_task_topic (con của Code 'NQ57', mã đầy đủ = 'NQ57.' + Code); nhiều nhãn ngăn cách ';';
               không có nhãn con -> 'Khác' */
        COALESCE((SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(p57.Code, '/', c57.TopicName) ORDER BY c57.SortOrder SEPARATOR ';')
                    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task_topic` c57
                    JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task_topic` p57 ON p57.TopicId = c57.ParentTopicId
                   WHERE p57.Code = 'NQ57' AND p57.DeletedDate IS NULL
                     AND c57.Code IS NOT NULL AND c57.DeletedDate IS NULL
                     AND t.TopicCode LIKE CONCAT('%"', p57.Code, '.', c57.Code, '"%')), 'Khác') AS nhan_chuyen_de,

        /* 04. Ngày ban hành, trích yếu văn bản giao */
        DATE(r_vb.StartDate)                                    AS ngay_ban_hanh_vb,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(r_vb.Compendium), ''),
            NULLIF(TRIM(t.Compendium), '')
        )                                                       AS trich_yeu_vb,

        /* 06. Số thứ tự nhóm NQ57 (số sau 'Nhóm ') để sắp xếp */
        CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(IF(t.NameGroup REGEXP 'Nhóm [0-9]', SUBSTRING(t.NameGroup, LOCATE('Nhóm ', t.NameGroup)), TRIM(LEADING '.' FROM TRIM(t.NameGroup)))), '')), 6), ':', 1), ' ', 1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(IF(t.NameGroup REGEXP 'Nhóm [0-9]', SUBSTRING(t.NameGroup, LOCATE('Nhóm ', t.NameGroup)), TRIM(LEADING '.' FROM TRIM(t.NameGroup)))), '')), 6), ':', 1), ' ', 1) AS UNSIGNED)
        END                                                     AS stt_nhom_nhiem_vu,

        /* 07. Thường trực BCĐ 57: chủ trì là Công an TP/xã, Tổ Thường trực, Tổ Tư vấn - chuyên gia */
        IF(CONCAT_WS(' ', dp2.name, dp3.name, dp4.name, dp5.name, dp6.name, t.ResponsibleUnit) LIKE '%Công an%'
           OR CONCAT_WS(' ', dp2.name, dp3.name, dp4.name, dp5.name, dp6.name, t.ResponsibleUnit) LIKE '%Tổ Thường trực%'
           OR CONCAT_WS(' ', dp2.name, dp3.name, dp4.name, dp5.name, dp6.name, t.ResponsibleUnit) LIKE '%Tổ Tư vấn%',
           1, 0)                                                AS la_thuong_truc_bcd,

        '${sync_ts}'                                            AS sync_date

    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

    /* CHỦ ĐỀ (1 TopicId / task -> không nhân dòng) */
    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task_topic` tp
           ON tp.TopicId = t.TopicId

    /* JOIN TÊN ĐƠN VỊ TRỤC GIAO CẤP 2 */
    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign_cap2
           ON d_assign_cap2.id = CASE
                WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
                ELSE NULL
              END
          AND d_assign_cap2.IsDelete = 0

    /* JOIN ĐƠN VỊ GIAO (BÓC TÁCH ID TỪ T.ASSIGNDEPARTMENT ĐỂ LẤY TÊN) */
    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign
           ON d_assign.id = CASE
                WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
                ELSE NULL
              END
          AND d_assign.IsDelete = 0

    /* JOIN NGƯỜI GIAO NHIỆM VỤ */
    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_assign
           ON u_assign.eGovUserId = t.AssignUser

    /* JOIN TÊN XÃ/PHƯỜNG: đoạn thứ 4 của TargetDepartment (490.698.1310.<xã>...) */
    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_cap
           ON d_cap.id = CASE
                WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
                ELSE NULL
              END
          AND d_cap.IsDelete = 0

    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_donvi
           ON d_donvi.id = CASE
                WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
                ELSE NULL
              END
          AND d_donvi.IsDelete = 0

    /* JOIN USER NHẬN */
    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target 
           ON u_target.eGovUserId = t.TargetUser

    /* VĂN BẢN GIAO (số, ngày ban hành, trích yếu, cơ quan ban hành) */
    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r_vb
           ON r_vb.ResolutionId = t.ResolutionId
          AND r_vb.DeletedDate IS NULL

    /* PATH ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ: dp1..dp6 = department của từng mã trong path
       COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490') */

    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` dp1
           ON dp1.id = CASE
                WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 1), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 1), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
              END

    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` dp2
           ON dp2.id = CASE
                WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', '')) >= 1
                 AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 2), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 2), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
              END

    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` dp3
           ON dp3.id = CASE
                WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', '')) >= 2
                 AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 3), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 3), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
              END

    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` dp4
           ON dp4.id = CASE
                WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', '')) >= 3
                 AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 4), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 4), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
              END

    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` dp5
           ON dp5.id = CASE
                WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', '')) >= 4
                 AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 5), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'

              END

    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` dp6
           ON dp6.id = CASE
                WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', '')) >= 5

                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 6), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
              END

    /* XÃ/PHƯỜNG NHẬN: đơn vị chủ trì là cơ quan cấp xã (bảng đối chiếu dm_xa_phuong_4truc_ddl.sql) */
    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`dm_xa_phuong_4truc` xa_nhan
           ON xa_nhan.id_don_vi = CASE
                WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490'), '.', 4), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'

              END
          AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.OriginalTargetDepartment), ''), '490') LIKE CONCAT(xa_nhan.nhanh, '.%')

    /* XÃ/PHƯỜNG NHẬN theo đơn vị nhận gốc (OriginalTargetDepartment) */
    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`dm_xa_phuong_4truc` xa_goc
           ON xa_goc.id_don_vi = CASE
                WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.OriginalTargetDepartment, '.', 4), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'

              END

    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_xa

      AND (   t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
           OR (t.Status IN (3, 4)
               AND (   COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 1
                    OR t.ExpireDate IS NULL
                    OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)))

      AND EXISTS (

      AND (

            MAX(eGovUserPositionName) AS position_name
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user`
        GROUP BY eGovUserId

    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            eGovUserId,
            MAX(eGovUserFullname)     AS fullname,
            MAX(eGovUserPositionId)   AS position_id,
            MAX(eGovUserPositionName) AS position_name

    /* Dòng gốc NV Thành phố giao nhiều chủ trì (TargetDepartment rỗng) -> để loại dòng con trùng Title */
    LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT g.Title
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` g

    WHERE t.DeletedDate IS NULL

          OR (t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.%'
              AND (NULLIF(TRIM(t.TargetDepartment), '') IS NULL OR goc57.Title IS NULL))
      )

    UNION ALL

    /* NHÁNH 2 · CẤP XÃ, PHƯỜNG */
    SELECT
        'Cấp Xã, phường'     AS cap_nhiem_vu,
        tl.TimelineId                                           AS timeline_id,
        tl.TaskId                                               AS task_id,
        t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,

        /* TÊN XÃ/PHƯỜNG (xem JOIN d_xa) */
        d_xa.name                                               AS ten_xa_phuong,

        COALESCE(tl.UserId, tl.CreateUser)                      AS nguoi_xu_ly_id,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(u_action.fullname, ''),
            NULLIF(u_create.fullname, ''),
            CAST(COALESCE(tl.UserId, tl.CreateUser) AS CHAR)

        COALESCE(u_action.position_id, u_create.position_id)    AS nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_id,

        COALESCE(

        tl.TargetUserId                                         AS nguoi_nhan_id,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(u_target.fullname, ''),
            CAST(tl.TargetUserId AS CHAR)
        )                                                       AS nguoi_nhan_name,

        u_target.position_id                                    AS nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_id,
        NULLIF(u_target.position_name, '')                      AS nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_name,

        tl.Role                                                 AS role,
        tl.ActionType                                           AS action_type,

        /* Map Description từ Enum Notification */
        CASE tl.ActionType
            WHEN 0 THEN 'Giao nhiệm vụ'
            WHEN 1 THEN 'Chỉnh sửa nhiệm vụ'
            WHEN 2 THEN 'Báo cáo công việc'
            WHEN 3 THEN 'Báo cáo % tiến độ'
            WHEN 4 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo công việc'
            WHEN 5 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo công việc'

            WHEN 13 THEN 'Yêu cầu báo cáo tiến độ'
            WHEN 14 THEN 'Gửi báo cáo'
            WHEN 15 THEN 'Xóa nhiệm vụ'
            WHEN 16 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo tiến độ'
            WHEN 17 THEN 'Duyệt xin gia hạn nhiệm vụ'
            WHEN 18 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo hoàn thành'
            WHEN 19 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo tiến độ'
            WHEN 20 THEN 'Từ chối xin gia hạn nhiệm vụ'
            WHEN 21 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo hoàn thành'
            WHEN 22 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo hoàn thành'
            WHEN 23 THEN 'Thu hồi xin gia hạn'
            WHEN 24 THEN 'Báo cáo lộ trình triển khai'
            WHEN 25 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo lộ trình'
            WHEN 26 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo lộ trình'
            WHEN 27 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo lộ trình'
            WHEN 28 THEN 'Được tạo bởi AI bóc tách nhiệm vụ'
            ELSE 'Khác'
        END                                                     AS ten_action_type,

        tl.Content                                              AS noi_dung,
        COALESCE(tl.ActionDate, tl.CreatedDate)                 AS action_date,
        '${sync_ts}'                                            AS sync_date

    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

    INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_timeline` tl
            ON tl.TaskId = t.TaskId

    /* XÃ/PHƯỜNG: department có id = đoạn thứ 4 của path 490.698.1310.<id>...
       Ưu tiên xã/phường nhận -> xã/phường giao */
    LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_xa
           ON d_xa.id = CASE
                WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                     CASE
                         WHEN t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1310.%' THEN t.OriginalTargetDepartment
                         ELSE t.AssignDepartment
                     END, '.', 4), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                     CASE
                         WHEN t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1310.%' THEN t.OriginalTargetDepartment
                         ELSE t.AssignDepartment
                     END, '.', 4), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
              END
          AND d_xa.IsDelete = 0

    /* DANH BẠ USER ĐÃ KHỬ TRÙNG eGovUserId - CHỈ GIỮ 4 CỘT CẦN DÙNG.
       Nhờ vậy 3 LEFT JOIN dưới đây không thể nhân dòng, bỏ được GROUP BY ở ngoài. */
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            eGovUserId,
            MAX(eGovUserFullname)     AS fullname,
            MAX(eGovUserPositionId)   AS position_id,

            MAX(eGovUserPositionId)   AS position_id,
            MAX(eGovUserPositionName) AS position_name

            MAX(eGovUserPositionId)   AS position_id,
            MAX(eGovUserPositionName) AS position_name
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user`
        GROUP BY eGovUserId
    ) u_target
           ON u_target.eGovUserId = tl.TargetUserId

    /* ĐIỀU KIỆN LẤY TASK: đồng bộ với qlnv_chitiet_captp_xp_bcd57 (nhánh cấp xã, phường) */
    WHERE t.DeletedDate IS NULL
      AND t.Status <> 5

      /* Tương đương x.tinh_trang <> 'Chưa xác định' bên chitiet */
      AND (   t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
           OR (t.Status IN (3, 4)
               AND (   COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 1
                    OR t.ExpireDate IS NULL
                    OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)))

      /* Task thuộc nghị quyết nhóm 55 (qua qlnv_task_resolution), EXISTS để không nhân dòng */
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task_resolution` tr
          INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r
                  ON r.ResolutionId = tr.ResolutionId
          WHERE tr.TaskId = t.TaskId
            AND r.ResolutionGroupId = 55
            AND r.DeletedDate IS NULL
      )

      /* Có liên quan đến xã/phường: xã/phường giao hoặc nhận (không tính người tham gia) */
      AND (
             t.OriginalTargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1310.%'
          OR t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.698.1310.%'
      )

Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Regular Expression.name: Regular Expression

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

Text to Prepend.name: Text to Prepend
Text to Prepend.description: The text to prepend to the start of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Text to Append.name: Text to Append

Character Set.name: Character Set

Maximum Buffer Size.name: Maximum Buffer Size
Maximum Buffer Size.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data to buffer (per file or per line, depending on the Evaluation Mode) in order to apply the replacement. If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

Evaluation Mode.name: Evaluation Mode

Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.name: Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode
Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) for all lines in the FlowFile, First Line (Header) alone, Last Line (Footer) alone, Except the First Line (Header) or Except the Last Line (Footer).

Support Fragmented Transactions.name: Support Fragmented Transactions
Support Fragmented Transactions.description: If true, when a FlowFile is consumed by this Processor, the Processor will first check the fragment.identifier and fragment.count attributes of that FlowFile. If the fragment.count value is greater than 1, the Processor will not process any FlowFile with that fragment.identifier until all are available; at that point, it will process all FlowFiles with that fragment.identifier as a single transaction, in the order specified by the FlowFiles' fragment.index attributes. This Provides atomicity of those SQL statements. Once any statement of this transaction throws exception when executing, this transaction will be rolled back. When transaction rollback happened, none of these FlowFiles would be routed to 'success'. If the <Rollback On Failure> is set true, these FlowFiles will stay in the input relationship. When the <Rollback On Failure> is set false,, if any of these FlowFiles will be routed to 'retry', all of these FlowFiles will be routed to 'retry'.Otherwise, they will be routed to 'failure'. If this value is false, these attributes will be ignored and the updates will occur independent of one another.

database-session-autocommit.name: database-session-autocommit
database-session-autocommit.description: The autocommit mode to set on the database connection being used. If set to false, the operation(s) will be explicitly committed or rolled back (based on success or failure respectively), if set to true the driver/database handles the commit/rollback.

Transaction Timeout.name: Transaction Timeout
Transaction Timeout.description: If the <Support Fragmented Transactions> property is set to true, specifies how long to wait for all FlowFiles for a particular fragment.identifier attribute to arrive before just transferring all of the FlowFiles with that identifier to the 'failure' relationship

Batch Size.name: Batch Size
Batch Size.description: The preferred number of FlowFiles to put to the database in a single transaction

Obtain Generated Keys.name: Obtain Generated Keys
Obtain Generated Keys.description: If true, any key that is automatically generated by the database will be added to the FlowFile that generated it using the sql.generate.key attribute. This may result in slightly slower performance and is not supported by all databases.

rollback-on-failure.name: rollback-on-failure
rollback-on-failure.description: Specify how to handle error. By default (false), if an error occurs while processing a FlowFile, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure' or 'retry' relationship based on error type, and processor can continue with next FlowFile. Instead, you may want to rollback currently processed FlowFiles and stop further processing immediately. In that case, you can do so by enabling this 'Rollback On Failure' property.  If enabled, failed FlowFiles will stay in the input relationship without penalizing it and being processed repeatedly until it gets processed successfully or removed by other means. It is important to set adequate 'Yield Duration' to avoid retrying too frequently.

Replacement Strategy.name: Replacement Strategy
Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

Regular Expression.name: Regular Expression
Regular Expression.description: The Search Value to search for in the FlowFile content. Only used for 'Literal Replace' and 'Regex Replace' matching strategies

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

Text to Prepend.name: Text to Prepend
Text to Prepend.description: The text to prepend to the start of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Text to Append.name: Text to Append
Text to Append.description: The text to append to the end of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Character Set.name: Character Set
Character Set.description: The Character Set in which the file is encoded

Maximum Buffer Size.name: Maximum Buffer Size
Maximum Buffer Size.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data to buffer (per file or per line, depending on the Evaluation Mode) in order to apply the replacement. If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

Evaluation Mode.name: Evaluation Mode
Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) or buffer the entire file into memory (Entire Text) and run against that.

Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.name: Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode
Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) for all lines in the FlowFile, First Line (Header) alone, Last Line (Footer) alone, Except the First Line (Header) or Except the Last Line (Footer).

File Size.name: File Size
File Size.description: The size of the file that will be used

Batch Size.name: Batch Size
Batch Size.description: The number of FlowFiles to be transferred in each invocation

Data Format.name: Data Format
Data Format.description: Specifies whether the data should be Text or Binary

Unique FlowFiles.name: Unique FlowFiles
Unique FlowFiles.description: If true, each FlowFile that is generated will be unique. If false, a random value will be generated and all FlowFiles will get the same content but this offers much higher throughput

generate-ff-custom-text.name: generate-ff-custom-text
generate-ff-custom-text.description: If Data Format is text and if Unique FlowFiles is false, then this custom text will be used as content of the generated FlowFiles and the File Size will be ignored. Finally, if Expression Language is used, evaluation will be performed only once per batch of generated FlowFiles

character-set.name: character-set
character-set.description: Specifies the character set to use when writing the bytes of Custom Text to a flow file.

mime-type.name: mime-type
mime-type.description: Specifies the value to set for the "mime.type" attribute.

relationships.name: failure
relationships.description: A FlowFile is routed to this relationship if the database cannot be updated and retrying the operation will also fail, such as an invalid query or an integrity constraint violation

relationships.name: retry
relationships.description: A FlowFile is routed to this relationship if the database cannot be updated but attempting the operation again may succeed

relationships.name: success
relationships.description: A FlowFile is routed to this relationship after the database is successfully updated

JDBC Connection Pool.name: JDBC Connection Pool
JDBC Connection Pool.description: Specifies the JDBC Connection Pool to use in order to convert the JSON message to a SQL statement. The Connection Pool is necessary in order to determine the appropriate database column types.

putsql-sql-statement.name: putsql-sql-statement
putsql-sql-statement.description: The SQL statement to execute. The statement can be empty, a constant value, or built from attributes using Expression Language. If this property is specified, it will be used regardless of the content of incoming FlowFiles. If this property is empty, the content of the incoming FlowFile is expected to contain a valid SQL statement, to be issued by the processor to the database.
